The DHI net-tools builds listed here were published without the backported upstream fix for this CVE that they were intended to carry; their binaries contain the same code as the unpatched upstream 2.10 release, so this CVE should be treated as present in these builds. A corrected DHI rebuild that applies the fix is pending.
